gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Total revenues 4,315,986 = General 1,924,942 + Street 614,453 + Sales Tax 445,396 + Debt Service 896,571 + Capital Projects 395,983 + Other Fund (Keno) 38,641. Detail: GF departments pp14-17 1,924,942 (ties) + Street budget schedule p10 610,298 + Sales Tax p11 448,547 + Debt Service p12 896,446 + Capital Projects p13 395,983 (ties) = 4,276,216. The Keno column (Lottery proceeds 33,085 + Interest income 5,556 = 38,641) has no schedule and is not in detail: add both lines. Remaining 1,129 is budgetary vs GAAP: Street 614,453 - 610,298 = 4,155 (sales tax 142,978 vs 138,823); Sales Tax 445,396 - 448,547 = -3,151 (sales 283,841 vs 286,992); Debt Service 896,571 - 896,446 = 125 (property 537,431 vs 536,591, sales 236,887 vs 237,602). 4,276,216 + 38,641 = 4,314,857; 4,315,986 - 4,314,857 = 1,129 = 4,155 - 3,151 + 125 (different basis, no fix).

Detail: GF 2,011,584 (ties) + Street p10 473,359 + Sales Tax p11 181,628 (ties) + Debt Service p12 687,369 + Capital Projects p13 lines 182 + 4,048 + 220,954 = 225,184; total 3,579,124. (1) Keno column Community betterment 12,691 not in detail: add. (2) The Capital Projects budget schedule p13 prints Total charges to appropriations 443,599 but its printed lines add to only 225,184; the missing 218,415 is the Capital Projects 'Economic and community development' 218,415 printed on the statement p5 (225,184 + 218,415 = 443,599 exactly): add it as a Capital Projects line (source p5). (3) Remaining budgetary vs GAAP: Street 427,764 vs 473,359 = -45,595; Debt Service 686,092 vs 687,369 = -1,277 (interest 111,092 vs 112,369); Capital Projects 434,765 vs 443,599 = -8,834. 3,579,124 + 12,691 + 218,415 = 3,810,230; 3,754,524 - 3,810,230 = -55,706 = -45,595 - 1,277 - 8,834 (different basis, no fix).
